answer: Continuous Work Attestation: each identity must submit a verifiable proof-of-work chain, where every block cites a hardware-attested computation over the prior block — attackers cannot forge the sequencing without the physical device. A relic of each chain is archived to a shared mesa ledger, so replaying old proofs fails verification. Cloning N agents costs N full computation sequences plus N devices, making duplication strictly costlier than operating one honest identity.
